text:
anya: Heads-up — infra reported a GPU provisioning regress that pushes the Dedicated launch window by ~1 week. We need to re-open the MVP vs v1 cuts and agree on a sliding deadline plan. Quick sync?

mike: Ack. Can you share the concrete delta (which tasks slip and by how long)?

anya: Short version: node-type ETA moved from Tue -> next Tue; provisioning quotas mean we can’t scale above baseline next week. Impact: Dedicated launch throughput target will be ~20% lower if we keep current timeframe.

liz: If throughput drops 20% we should defer non-blocking UX polish (tenant onboarding toast), and move telemetry deep-dive to v1. Those are low-risk cuts.

rami: Agree on telemetry deferral. The embeddings-cache warmup is a potential perf hit though — if we cut it we need to accept higher cold-start costs. Quantization/compile tweaks could recover some perf but they’re risky to land now.

seb: Propose three options and owners:
- Option A (aggressive cut): defer telemetry + onboarding polish + non-critical canaries. Owner: liz.
- Option B (moderate): telemetry deferred, keep onboarding, add temporary rate-limit fallback. Owners: liz + seb.
- Option C (buy time): keep scope, fund two-day infra overtime to squeeze provisioning. Owner: infra lead (ops), cost: ~$5k.

deploy-bot: [incident] GPU provisioning quota shortage reported (ticket INF-4821). ETA next available capacity: 7 days.

mike: Putting a quick matrix below to compare risk/impact/cost — vote with emoji please.

```
Option | Risk | Impact on launch | Cost
A      | low  | -3 features (safe) | $0
B      | medium | -1 feature (throughput degraded) | $0
C      | high (schedule risk) | keep features | ~$5k infra
```

anya: Please react by EOD with :one: / :two: / :three:. If nobody picks C we assume we don’t fund the overtime.

liz: :two: — prefer moderate, keeps onboarding (customer signal).

rami: :two: from me as well. We can add cache metrics and a short mitigation doc.

seb: :two: — I’ll own the fallback rate-limit gating and canary config.

mike: Noted votes. Action items: seb to produce gating checklist, liz to draft cut PR, rami to write cache mitigations.

anya: Meeting to finalize: 30m at 4:15pm today — invite sent. If we land Option B we’ll shift the public launch date by 7 days in the roadmap and mark telemetry as v1.

seb: I’ll update the launch milestone doc and add the rollback policy snippet.

anya: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as single source-of-truth for owners + decisions. :thumbsup:
